actions.create_post.description: Create or schedule a post on one or more connected channels
actions.create_post.props.content.descri: The text content of the post
actions.create_post.props.date.descripti: The date and time to publish the post (ISO 8601 format). Required for scheduled posts.
actions.create_post.props.integration.de: Select the connected social media channel
actions.create_post.props.media.descript: File paths of images or videos to attach. Upload media first using the "Upload File from URL" action, then paste the returned path here.
actions.create_post.props.settings.descr: Optional platform-specific settings (e.g. approval workflow overrides)
actions.create_post.props.shortLink.desc: Automatically shorten URLs in the post content
actions.create_post.props.type.descripti: Choose whether to publish immediately, schedule for later, or save as draft
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_post.description: Delete a post and all other posts in the same group
actions.delete_post.props.postId.descrip: The ID of the post to delete. You can get this from the "List Posts" or "New Published Post" trigger output.
actions.find_available_slot.description: Find the next available posting time slot for a connected channel
actions.find_available_slot.props.integr: Select the connected social media channel
actions.get_platform_analytics.descripti: Retrieve analytics (followers, impressions, engagement) for a connected channel
actions.get_platform_analytics.props.day: Number of days to look back for analytics (e.g. 7, 30, 90)
actions.get_platform_analytics.props.int: Select the connected social media channel
actions.get_post_analytics.description: Retrieve analytics (likes, comments, shares, impressions) for a specific published post
actions.get_post_analytics.props.days.de: Number of days to look back for analytics (e.g. 7, 30, 90)
The ID of the published post. You can get this from the "List Posts" or "New Published Post" trigger output.
actions.list_integrations.description: List all connected social media channels in your organization
actions.list_posts.description: Retrieve posts within a date range
actions.list_posts.props.endDate.descrip: End of the date range (ISO 8601 format)
actions.list_posts.props.startDate.descr: Start of the date range (ISO 8601 format)
actions.upload_file_from_url.description: Upload a media file from a URL to Postiz. Returns the file path to use when creating posts.
actions.upload_file_from_url.props.url.d: The public URL of the image or video to upload
